contracts.metric_event_definition: Net Booked Revenue: eligible BOOKED orders net approved discount.
contracts.aggregation_grain: additive non-overlapping order slices; one order
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: null blocked; dedupe order; late/restatement disclosed

contracts.metric_event_definition: Session Conversion Rate: eligible sessions with attributed booking / eligible sessions.
contracts.formula_numerator_denominator: distinct converted sessions / distinct eligible sessions; zero denominator=NULL
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: missing link reasoned; event/session dedupe; open cohort restates

contracts.metric_event_definition: Refund Rate: eligible refunded orders / eligible fulfilled orders.
contracts.formula_numerator_denominator: distinct refunded order / distinct eligible fulfilled order
contracts.time_window_timezone_unit: fulfilled_at with refund window; finance timezone; percent
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: missing state blocked; refund/order dedupe; late refund restates open cohort

contracts.metric_event_definition: Median First Response Time for eligible support tickets.
contracts.formula_numerator_denominator: median business minutes; eligible responded tickets
contracts.time_window_timezone_unit: opened cohort; business calendar; Asia/Bangkok; minutes
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: unresponded separate; ticket dedupe; calendar revision logged

contracts.metric_event_definition: Pipeline Freshness Lag: evaluation time minus latest successful authorized load.
contracts.formula_numerator_denominator: elapsed seconds; eligible governed pipeline run
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: missing success explicit; run dedupe; late logs revised with audit

contracts.metric_event_definition: Weekly Active Accounts: distinct eligible accounts with qualifying events.
contracts.null_duplicate_late_restatement: null account blocked; event dedupe; late event restates open week
